title: How to set up your emergency contacts and medical ID on your iPhone - Engadget
summary: By default, Emergency SOS uses the same button combination as turning off your iPhone: the Side button and either Volume button. Emergency SOS is not available via the Action Button (on the left side, above the volume buttons), however.
